page_note: Page is dominated by substrate cosmological-anthropological teaching: the soul wearing a body, the Mind of Light coming with Wisdom and Hearing to establish the New Man, the mechanics of tarachē (disturbance) caused by powers/stars above, the mixture of bitterness/desire/grief/lupē with the Sin in the body via food and water, and the alternative state when the food comes in established with light and life. The teaching is impersonal cosmic mechanics throughout, addressed in 2nd person to a soul. Only seg 24 carries a clear hortatory marker (ⲁⲓ̈ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲉⲧⲕ — 'I have made known unto thee'). Heavy lacunae (70.6%) limit certainty for several damaged segments.
